response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT p.product_color AS color, SUM(ili.derived_total_cost) AS amt FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), s AS (SELECT color, amt, amt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(amt) FROM c) AS share, (SELECT AVG(amt) FROM c) AS avg_amt FROM c) SELECT AVG(amt) AS avg_invoiced_amount, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(amt - avg_amt) AS avg_above_color_average FROM s WHERE amt > avg_amt
